question: Can the opt-in external trajectory v2 loader enforce declared source-episode grouping before tensor loading while preserving v1 data and all historical research?
observation: v1 rejects full copied trajectories but explicitly cannot identify overlapping windows from a shared source episode when content and row IDs differ. Source grouping is still an unresolved admission requirement.
contract: Add format ripii-trajectory-dataset-v2 with a required source_groups object keyed by every declared split. Each list entry contains trajectory_id (nonbool int), source_id (nonempty bounded string), episode_id (nonempty bounded string). Require globally unique row IDs, one declared source/episode pair in only one split, exact one-to-one row-ID coverage with each loaded NPZ, complete records and no extras. Validate all metadata groups before any archive read. Emit row-aligned group IDs plus per-split unique group count and canonical group digest in the loaded data record. Exact content checks remain independent and mandatory in full verification. v1 remains supported and receives no inferred identity. Physical independence is caller-declared, not authenticated by this contract.
implementation: Extend manifest admission and record construction in ripii/world/external_data.py with a versioned grouping helper, tests, usage specification and retained generated fixture. No model, training objective, existing protocol, or historical data is changed. No statistical aggregation or external provenance claim is added.
falsifier: A shared declared episode crosses splits; a metadata row is missing/duplicated/unmatched; group records cannot be traced to loaded row IDs and manifest bytes; legacy v1 tensor behavior changes.
qualification: This supplies executable data admission for a future protocol, not empirical independence or a new hypothesis. Historical negative/no-advance dispositions stay closed.

implementation_clarification_before_test.identities: Signed int64 trajectory IDs; exact printable source/episode strings of 1 to 256 characters with no leading/trailing whitespace. No alias inference. Duplicate JSON keys are rejected, including ambiguous v1 manifests; ordinary valid v1 records remain unchanged.
implementation_clarification_before_test.composition_gap: Training CLI and external benchmark verify then reload split files. Add optional expected_manifest_sha256 admission to load_trajectory_split and pass the complete-verifier digest through both callers so a replacement cannot compose separately validated snapshots. Single-split evaluation can still opt into a supplied digest; it does not silently certify all other split contents.
